title: Woman arrested for allegedly stabbing horse in front of child who was at ranch for therapy
text:
BREVARD COUNTY, Fla. (Gray News) – A Florida woman is charged with animal cruelty after allegedly stabbing a horse multiple times.

Brevard County Sheriff Wayne Ivey accused 69-year-old Shirley Zimmerley, of Cocoa, of using a knife to stab the horse in front of a child who was at a ranch for therapy on July 27.

“She stabbed a freaking horse with a knife, then took and started whipping the horse because she was frustrated over the horse’s behavior,” Ivey said.

According to Ivey, the child went home and told their parents, who then contacted the sheriff’s office.

Authorities responded to the ranch and found the malnourished horse with multiple stab wounds and whip marks, Ivey said.

Other horses on the ranch also appeared to have open sores.

Zimmerley blamed the injuries on a cat.

“This is not only unacceptable, it’s insane,” Ivey said.

Zimmerley was taken into custody by the department’s fugitive unit and animal cruelty investigators. She was booked at the Brevard County Jail on one felony charge and two misdemeanor counts of animal cruelty.

The judge set Zimmerley’s bond at $10,000, a decision Ivey appeared to disagree with.

“Let me set the bonds. Please, God, let me start setting them because they won’t ever get out of jail. I can promise you that,” Ivey added.
